text: Managing a team requires a mix of skills, but the most important is clear communication. You must share goals and expectations openly, so everyone knows their role. Delegation is equally crucial: trust your team members with tasks that suit their strengths, rather than doing everything yourself. Regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued, while positive feedback keeps motivation high. However, disagreements will happen. When conflict arises, address it calmly and listen to both sides before finding a fair solution. By balancing these elements, you can build a productive and supportive team environment.
